name: echoes-of-the-abyss
description: Browser-native RTS with acoustic fog of war set in the Pelagion Rift

scripts.dev: npm -w packages/frontend run dev & npm -w packages/backend run dev
scripts.build: npm -w packages/frontend run build && npm -w packages/backend run build
scripts.test: npm -w packages/frontend run test && npm -w packages/backend run test
scripts.lint: npm -w packages/frontend run lint && npm -w packages/backend run lint
